# aidigest

The AI-native layer that digests any web page into minimal tokens. Measurable, safe, transparent. For any agent, any model, any website.

# AI-Ready standard

Publishers adopt llms.txt and an AI-Readiness Score so agents consume structured, low-token content. Adoption compounds between sites and agents.
